stem: A body is dropped from the top of a given tower of height h. At the same time a body is projected from the foot of the tower, in the same vertical line, with a velocity which would be just sufficient to take it to top of the tower. They will meet at a height?

assets.alt: A tower of height h. One ball is dropped from the top and another is thrown up from the ground at u = √(2gh). They meet h/4 below the top, 3h/4 above the ground.
